title: 1995 development tools comparison
requirements: Exactly five rows: Visual Basic 4, Visual C++ 4 / MFC, Borland Delphi 1.0, PowerBuilder, Java 1.0.
Columns: language/tooling, GUI approach, script’s stated strength, script’s stated tradeoff. Draft cells from the provided narration; retain an internal source-per-cell table.
Mark subjective claims such as ease or ugliness as script characterization in the working data; final wording needs editorial approval.
Do not assert all named product/version labels were simultaneously released in the target year until chronology is checked. No logos or box art are required.
beats: Full-table still plus optional row-focus states for VB, Delphi, and Java.
Keep consistent column widths; split to two connected slides only if the entire chart cannot pass readability review.
checks: All five rows present; each factual cell links to script lines and verification status.
No price, market-share percentage, invented rating, or benchmark is added.
The tradeoff column does not caricature one tool through deliberately broken code.
